name: Cyber End Dragon
source_text: "Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon" A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. During battle between this card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.
notes: The Fusion Summon recipe is rules data; the script covers the printed battle effect.

scripts.source_text: During battle with a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage.
